This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.19/2023, registered at Police Station-Mahila Thana,
Narmadapuram (MP) for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that prosecutrix is married lady, aged 24 years and is major.

As per prosecution story, applicant took her to Hoshangabad and where he committed Tanish Jaiswal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130378343/
1 rape on her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He also took her photographs and blackmailed her and by blackmailing committed rape twice with her.
Counsel appearing for applicant submitted that whole story is concocted.
Applicant is young boy aged about 22 years and is a student and prosecutrix was consenting party and on her own, she went with applicant.
There is delay in lodging of FIR.
The incident is said to have taken place in last week of February, 2023 and complaint has been lodged in June, 2023.
Reason for delay has not been explained by the prosecution.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted benefit of anticipatory bail.

3. Government Advocate appearing for State as well as prosecutrix, present in person, opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and submitted that applicant has taken her photographs and she is also being threatened by applicant that he may throw acid on her.
In these circumstances, prayer is made for dismissal of anticipatory bail application.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is major, aged about 24 years.
She was already married.
There is delay in lodging of FIR.
Applicant is young boy, aged about 22 years and is a student.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

Ion following conditions :
(i) Applicant will surrender his mobile phone/laptop before Investigating Officer for it's examination;
(ii) Applicant will not threaten the prosecutrix in any way and will not try to approach her.
7.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the police in the aforesaid FIR, applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting officer (Investigating Officer)/trial Court for his regular appearance before the Police during the investigation or before the Court during trial.

8. It is directed that applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
